title: Brain Dump
description: This is a ongoing mod of all my stupid and (maybe) good ideas. I hope you enjoy!
body:
Welcome to a mod full of creativity, chaos, and random ideas brought to life! This project is a collection of some of my best — and weirdest — Minecraft mod concepts, all combined into one experience. Some features are serious, some are experimental, and some exist just because they sounded fun.

Current features include:

The Metallic Dimension
The Metal Forest
The Scurrier
The Gilded Lily
And more constantly being added!

This mod focuses on exploration, strange creatures, unique environments, and fun mechanics. Not everything is perfectly balanced — the goal is to create memorable and interesting gameplay.

I’m always open to feedback, suggestions, and new ideas, so feel free to share them. More content, features, and chaos are planned for future updates!
